priorityList.notes: Tiger's Fury on cooldown for the free energy; it costs nothing and the engine gates it on its own 30 second cooldown.
Keep Rake ticking; it is a strong bleed that costs no combo point.

At 5 combo points, Rip once it has under 6s left. Fix round: the engine's Rip carries a fixed 12s duration rather than one that scales with combo points (engine lane 1's report), and this bare build's only combo generator is Shred, which reaches 5 combo points slower than a talented/geared build would -- gating the refresh on `not dotIsActive` meant Rip was ALWAYS already expired by the time 5 combo points arrived, so the branch below (Ferocious Bite with Rip up) was unreachable every time, not just occasionally. dotRemainingTime < 6s refreshes a little before the DoT actually falls off, the same clip-avoidance shape as warrior-arms' Rend upkeep, and leaves the Bite branch below reachable whenever Rip still has real time on it.

At 5 combo points with Rip having more than 6s left, Ferocious Bite dumps them instead of capping out. Fix round: paired with the dotRemainingTime rewrite above, this is the branch engine lane 1's report found unreachable under the engine's fixed 12s Rip.
Shred builds combo points the rest of the time.

Claw is meant only as the fallback builder below level 22, before Shred is learned (druid.md audit finding 2) -- the earlier notes here (superseded) diagnosed sim/druid/claw.go's registerClawSpell as a single hardcoded-id registration with no per-rank loop, unlike Shred and Rake; re-checked against the pinned engine (rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28) and that has since been fixed -- registerClawSpell now does the same core.HighestRankAtLevel(clawLearnLevels, druid.Level) per-rank lookup Shred and Rake use, with a real clawSpellID[rank] table (1082/3029/5201/9849/9850 at levels 20/28/38/48/58), so Claw casts correctly at every level from 20 on, not just 20-21. That fix exposed a real rotation defect this line did not have before: with no upper gate, Claw kept competing with Shred at every level Shred is also known, and Claw's 45-energy cost (spellconst) undercuts Shred's 60 -- the ladder's own level-60 run (before this fix) showed Claw firing 26.5 times/iteration against Shred's 1.4, Claw winning the energy race almost every time it was available and starving the strictly stronger filler (Shred's 2.25x damage multiplier vs Claw's 1x) out of the rotation entirely. Gated on `not spellIsKnown(Shred)` the same way rogue-subtlety gates its Sinister Strike fallback on `not spellIsKnown(Hemorrhage)`: rewriteRotationRanks resolves the referenced Shred id to whichever rank is currently learned (or leaves it unrewritten and unresolvable below level 22, where Shred is not learned at all), so the gate reads correctly at every level without hardcoding a level check the APL language does not have.
